across_noise_selection.primary_rule: Prefer the recipe and settings producing the best overall evaluated structures across tau0.1,0.3,0.8. Combine per-interface reference agreement, support for uncovered interfaces, and whole-assembly physical quality.
across_noise_selection.isolated_weaker_result: A weaker outcome at one tau does not disqualify a recipe or require a separate diagnostic experiment when another setting produces better overall candidates.
across_noise_selection.recording: Retain all outcomes, winning tau/settings, seeds, ancestry, and reference scope. A selected best candidate is not an estimate of typical success or a calibrated acceptance claim.
across_noise_selection.iteration: Preserve successful constraints and target remaining structural defects. Investigate sampling-versus-rule causes only when a systematic problem obstructs progress; isolated variability has no established causal explanation.

ranking_history.rationale: Promote v7 as the provisional preferred raw recipe, job58234698 tau0.3 FK2, while retaining relaxed v4 job58197169 as the cleaner physical alternative. E/F species-surrogate DockQ improves from v4raw0.845/0.856 to0.935/0.920; Q89 errors improve from about4.1A to1.45/1.47A, T83 errors are0.46/0.50A, and severe interchain CNO falls22 to7. N60-E362 worsens to+6.36/+5.63A and must remain explicit. FK2 also has3 severe intrachain CNO,10 backbone length outliers and6/27 native SS distances outside the diagnostic1.8-2.3A window (one borderline). All10 winning FK descendants have ancestor6; baseline6 already has a useful basin. Conserved1LX5 species-surrogate agreement covers typeII E/F,392/716 residues; ACVR1 C/D and native full-assembly accuracy remain unvalidated.
